obligations.note: Payments privileged idle is set to 16 in both policy.py and controls/payments/policy-params.json. SES-1 requires that value to be at most 15, so a privileged session can remain accepted after 15 idle minutes.
Ticket CHG-26241 is approved by change manager Grace Kim before review, and its components (payments.policy and payments.controls-data) match both files the commit touches.
Mara Costa, a payments change approver and not the author, approved a code review of commit e650d922b65fa43a6ee1a4bc1b2fd4d9788e5461.
The change is a single commit, and both the code review and the control-owner approval name that head commit.
CI run.json records a successful payments suite on the head commit, with 172 tests, none skipped or failed, including the exhaustive SES-1 control test test_privileged_idle_timeout_within_policy.
The touched components payments.policy and payments.controls-data are not marked security_sensitive, so a security review is not required.
The policy-params edit is a protected control change. Bao Tran, a control owner on the controls-office team, approved the head commit, and the author is on payments-eng.
Ticket CHG-26241 is type standard and the change record is not an emergency, so no post-implementation review is due.
The cited exception EXC-0253 is for mortgage.session, not this payments policy change. EXC-0141 is for payments.session and SES-1 but expired on 2026-09-23, before review on 2026-10-23.
Acceptance-ledger entries cover other paths and symbols. This diff does not change that covered code, so those earlier records do not lapse.

summary: The change raises Payments' privileged idle limit from 15 minutes to 16 in both the code constant and the approved policy parameter, which violates SES-1. The risk exception cited in the change request does not authorize that deviation: EXC-0253 covers Mortgage sessions, and the Payments session exception EXC-0141 had already expired. Change-ticket, independent approval, testing, and control-owner records are in order, but the idle-timeout breach is enough to reject the change.
